description: The surfaces a person actually opens, for the identity this token belongs to, as `kind`: "assigned" (default; open records assigned to them, with who set them and when), "created", "assigned_by_me", "waiting" (approvals they can decide, each with `rule_label` (the automation rule asking: its name if you may read that database's automations, else "A rule in <database>") and unanswered mentions), "recent", "favorites". Finished records are never returned; lists are per database, at most 50 rows each, with an exact `total` and `truncated: true` when cut, so a count is never the size of one page. Your own surfaces only. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES get_my_work"]
